user_request: Build the Founder Coach plugin following the 5-phase execution plan
approved_decisions: Architecture: Claude Code plugin with single /coach skill

intent.goal: Build a Claude Code plugin that acts as a daily AI coach for founders
acceptance_criteria: First session delivers value in under 2 minutes
Decision log captures and resurfaces decisions
Weekly review gives real percentage scores
10 founders can install and use independently

normalized_phases.title: Plugin Skeleton + First Run Flow
normalized_phases.objective: Establish plugin structure and first-run detection/scaffolding
normalized_phases.exit_criteria: Running /coach creates all config and state files, displays welcome. Second /coach detects SETUP_INCOMPLETE.

normalized_phases.title: Morning Session + Streak Tracking
normalized_phases.objective: Implement morning session flow and streak tracking logic
normalized_phases.exit_criteria: Morning session produces 3 goal-tied actions, streak entry created, re-run routes to evening.

normalized_phases.title: Evening Session + Scoreboard
normalized_phases.objective: Implement evening check-in and scoreboard tracking
normalized_phases.exit_criteria: Evening prompts completion, updates scoreboard, captures decisions, updates streak.json.

normalized_phases.title: Weekly Review + LinkedIn Guide + References
normalized_phases.objective: Weekly review session and reference files
normalized_phases.exit_criteria: Friday weekly review shows scores, decision review, strategy alignment. LinkedIn drafts work.

normalized_phases.title: End-to-End Polish + README + Distribution
normalized_phases.objective: Error handling, README, license, final verification
normalized_phases.exit_criteria: Full loop works. README accurate. Plugin installable.
